The Dynamic Cold Therapy 0.8 HP Cold & Heat Chiller is designed to provide efficient temperature control and water maintenance for compatible Dynamic Cold Therapy tubs. Equipped with both cooling and heating capabilities, this all-in-one system allows users to maintain water temperatures ranging from 37°F to 85°F, making it suitable for both cold plunge recovery and warm water therapy.

The integrated WiFi-enabled mobile app allows you to monitor and control your chiller remotely from anywhere with a WiFi connection. Users can adjust temperatures, automate schedules, and manage system performance directly from their smartphone.

To simplify maintenance, the chiller includes a self-priming circulation pump, two-stage filtration system, 20-micron replaceable filters, and an automated natural ozone sanitation system, helping maintain clean and clear water with minimal effort.

products.body_html:
Product Description

Elevate your home wellness experience with the Dynamic Vila Grande 4-Person Full Spectrum Near Zero EMF Infrared Sauna, a spacious luxury indoor sauna designed for advanced infrared therapy, modern relaxation, and elegant contemporary living. Crafted from environmentally-friendly Canadian Hemlock with a sophisticated Honey Dark Stain finish, the DYN-6415-03 FS combines premium craftsmanship with advanced Full Spectrum infrared technology for a refined spa-quality experience at home.

The Dynamic Vila Grande features a powerful Full Spectrum heating system with 8 total heaters, including 4 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels and 4 Near IR heating elements. This advanced heating configuration combines FAR infrared and Near IR wavelengths to deliver deep, evenly distributed warmth while maintaining EMF levels under 3MG measured 2 to 3 inches from the heating elements.

Designed for larger wellness sessions, the spacious 4-person interior offers generous comfort for couples, families, or shared recovery experiences. The sauna’s environmentally-friendly Canadian Hemlock construction provides durability, thermal efficiency, and timeless natural beauty, while the Honey Dark Stain finish enhances its premium luxury aesthetic.

The modern design is complemented by clear tempered glass doors and side windows, creating an open and inviting atmosphere while maintaining a sleek contemporary appearance. Integrated chromotherapy color lighting and a dedicated red light therapy feature help create a calming spa-inspired environment designed to support relaxation, rejuvenation, and overall wellness.

For entertainment and convenience, the sauna includes Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connectivity paired with built-in speakers, allowing you to enjoy music, meditation sessions, or podcasts during every sauna experience. Interior LED control panels provide intuitive operation and convenient temperature management.

The Dynamic Vila Grande requires a dedicated 120V/20AMP non-GFCI electrical receptacle and breaker for optimal heating performance and is designed exclusively for indoor residential installation. Its versatile design allows installation in home gyms, wellness rooms, basements, master bathrooms, walk-in closets, or dedicated spa spaces.
